title: A Provision for the Wreck
premise: Cyrus Amberdale, a disgraced mountain guide living under a borrowed name in the border town of Vell's Landing, pulls a sealed chest from a flooded river and finds it stamped with the crest of Karveth—a nation erased from every map twenty years ago. Inside are documents proving the disaster that ruined Cyrus's reputation was engineered to bury what an earlier expedition found in the high passes. Hunted by the syndicate that manufactured the cover-up and shadowed by a client who may be Karvethi royalty in hiding, Cyrus must lead one last expedition through the mountains to deliver proof of the truth. In the end, Cyrus chooses truth over survival, exposing the syndicate at the cost of their anonymity—and finally reclaiming their own name.
about_author: Edmund Delacroix is the pen name of a former alpine rescue volunteer who spent a decade guiding in ranges he still refuses to name. He writes adventure fiction from a cabin with unreliable electricity and a dog named after a storm.

chapters.title: What the River Keeps
chapters.summary: Cyrus Amberdale, working under the alias 'Maren Vale,' drags a half-drowned client out of the spring flood and hooks a chest snagged in the shallows—stamped with the seal of dead Karveth. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: wary curiosity curdling into dread as Cyrus recognizes the seal from the expedition that destroyed them.

chapters.title: The Client Who Lies Well
chapters.summary: A wealthy traveler named Ilsa Reyne hires Cyrus to guide her up the Serpent's Spine, claiming to survey mining claims—but she asks pointed questions about the old Karveth routes. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: the tightening coil of suspicion; Cyrus realizes the chest has made them visible again.

chapters.title: Blacklist
chapters.summary: A flashback chapter: eight years ago, young guide Cyrus led the Karveth Recovery Expedition; three clients died in a 'storm' that never appeared on any forecast, and Cyrus took the blame across two borders. POV: Cyrus (past). Emotional beat: grief and rage braided together—the wound that made invisibility feel like safety.

chapters.title: Men Who Don't Knock
chapters.summary: Two strangers search Cyrus's boathouse while they're out; the chest is gone, but Cyrus kept the documents hidden inside a rope coil. A syndicate courier leaves a warning: return what the river gave up or be reported. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: cold fear hardening into defiance—the moment hiding stops being an option.

chapters.title: Ilsa's Map
chapters.summary: Cyrus confronts Ilsa; she reveals a hand-drawn map of the Karveth passes and admits she is the daughter of the expedition's vanished cartographer. She knows who Cyrus really is. POV: Ilsa. Emotional beat: reluctant alliance—two liars recognizing each other's scars.

chapters.title: The Ascent of Liars
chapters.summary: The expedition begins: Cyrus, Ilsa, two porters, and a syndicate plant named Broch embedded among them. Weather turns early; a bridge washes out, forcing them onto the forbidden Karveth route. POV: alternating Cyrus and Broch. Emotional beat: rising dread—Broch's orders are not to retrieve documents but to ensure no witnesses descend.

chapters.title: The Pass That Remembers
chapters.summary: Above the cloud line they find the wrecked camp of the original expedition and evidence the 'storm' was sabotage: cut anchor lines, a tampered stove. One porter falls in a crevasse; Broch hesitates a beat too long before throwing the rope. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: horror and confirmation—the past repeating itself exactly.

chapters.title: Whiteout
chapters.summary: Trapped in a storm shelter, Cyrus exposes Broch; a knife fight ends with Broch falling into the white and the group's trust shattered. Ilsa confesses her father didn't vanish—he was murdered for his maps, which she carries tattooed into memory. POV: Ilsa. Emotional beat: betrayal and raw honesty; loyalty to companions vs. loyalty to truth comes to a head.

chapters.title: Descent
chapters.summary: The survivors race down the mountain ahead of the syndicate's second team, using Ilsa's memorized map through terrain no living person should know. Cyrus nearly repeats the old disaster but chooses to burn time saving a porter rather than secure the documents. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: redemption in motion—this time, everyone gets brought home.

chapters.title: A Provision for the Wreck
chapters.summary: In Vell's Landing, Cyrus delivers the documents to a border tribunal and testifies under their true name, surrendering the alias and accepting arrest warrants from two countries rather than let the truth die quietly. The syndicate fractures; Ilsa walks free carrying her father's legacy restored. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: costly peace—survival traded for identity, and worth it.
